Engineering

高压燃油

Fuel oil pressurized to high levels for injection into main engine cylinders, delivered by high-pressure pumps as specified by engine manufacturer and SOLAS for efficient combustion.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 高压燃油?

In this glossary, 高压燃油 refers to: Fuel oil pressurized to high levels for injection into main engine cylinders, delivered by high-pressure pumps as specified by engine manufacturer and SOLAS for efficient combustion.

How is 高压燃油 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "机舱，在启动主机前请检查所有高压燃油管路是否有泄漏，并确保所有连接都牢固。"
